scope.purpose: Make bare local-workspace imports resolve from the exact current linked worktree before Node can follow an ancestor checkout workspace link.

rootCause.symptomBeforeRepair: The G4 L9 private product-bridge descriptor saw the dirty ancestor checkout's @helpmath/demos registry and failed 2 of 3 tests even though the subject worktree contained the correct registry.
rootCause.mechanismBeforeRepair: The resolve hook called nextResolve first and consulted the exact current-worktree workspace map only after ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Because this worktree is nested below another checkout with an installed workspace link, Node found that ancestor link and never threw.
